visuals.review: Accepted nine final canvas views: smooth ivory shell, painted irregular brown bands, readable aperture and unbanded interior from both sides and front-quarter; desktop/phone inspection fit; seagrass and kelp bending at two deterministic times with fixed roots.
visuals.fixturePreservation: Strict same-seed plant position, height, variant, yaw, instance matrices and camera equality before/after. Nautilus views use existing inspection controls. Actual scene lighting, fog and surrounding objects are retained.

source.scope: One nautilus shell factory block and five guarded plant-helper/wiring/motion edits. Other species, nautilus non-shell rig, strategy, input, depth, collision, feeding and scene lighting are preserved.

plants.vertexWork: Two sine and two cosine evaluations plus inverse-shear normal correction; no added fragment work.

limits: Illustrative procedural nautilus proportions and the preserved generic head/hood/filaments are not a specimen reconstruction.
Plant sway is decorative motion, not a simulated water-current field.
CPU root/normal checks, native shader/uniform checks and deterministic stills do not establish GPU vertex readback, FPS or temporal shimmer performance.
